title: VW Bus
content: This magnificent old Volkswagen bus was parked in my mechanic’s lot.I couldn’t resist doing a miniature watercolor portrait of it while I waited around for my car inspection.My family used to own a VW bus, a slightly newer model. It was terribly underpowered, and gave an earnest whine as it struggled slowly up even the smallest hill. People would pass us, laughing.-----Previously:Mud PuddleBook about the VW Camper
